reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: src/pattern.rs owns staged GNU compiled-pattern objects. A caller pattern slot owns an allocated GNU buffer and its native internal allocations; converted patterns are temporary, and match registers now live in local fixed arrays.
owner_creation.invariant: Compiled pattern and per-match register owners are separate.
limitations: The GNU compiled object owns native internals as well as outer allocation.

aliases_escapes.analysis: src/pattern.rs lends line bytes to native search. Re_search borrows the line and local register arrays; returned match endpoints borrow line storage and become stale when that line owner changes.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Match endpoints cannot outlive their source line.
limitations: Match endpoints borrow the searched line and expire with that owner.

callback_targets.analysis: src/pattern.rs calls GNU routines with process-global syntax state. GNU entry points are direct calls, but re_set_syntax changes process-global state and filter handlers may free a pattern while another operation borrows it.
callback_targets.invariant: Named native functions do not protect compiled-owner lifetime.
limitations: Process-global syntax and native ABI rules extend beyond the local direct call.

invalidation.analysis: src/pattern.rs replaces compiled owners only after successful staging. Successful replacement regfrees/frees the old compiled owner and publishes the new pointer; uncompile nulls the slot after release, while failed compilation retains the old slot.
invalidation.invariant: Pattern replacement invalidates all old compiled aliases.

mutation_commit.analysis: src/pattern.rs restores syntax before recovery entry. Compile stages a new object and restores prior syntax before error/recovery; native layout bitfields and narrowed offsets remain explicit ABI/range contracts.
mutation_commit.invariant: Staging does not prove copied native ABI layout.

release_pair.analysis: src/pattern.rs pairs native regfree with outer free. Successful compiled objects require regfree followed by free; local REGS_FIXED arrays need no native free, and converted temporary text is freed after compilation.
release_pair.invariant: Stack registers must never be passed to native free.
limitations: regfree and outer free apply to compiled objects, not stack REGS_FIXED arrays.

error_cleanup.analysis: src/pattern.rs frees failed candidates before returning. Compile failure frees staged storage and can report an error; source review does not rederive native partial-compile cleanup semantics or every narrowing boundary.
error_cleanup.invariant: Failure cleanup still needs the canonical native contract.

signals_handoff.analysis: src/pattern.rs leaves filter lifetime exclusion unresolved. The syntax value is restored on both source paths, but signal-driven filter cleanup can still retire borrowed compiled data; existing native/signal findings remain open.
signals_handoff.invariant: Borrowed pattern lifetime is not protected from handlers.
limitations: Current fixed registers and syntax restoration are preserved improvements. M0-LEAK-001 and M0-FFI-001 remain open records, not claims of a newly reproduced leak/global-syntax failure.

src/signal.rs.relationship: set_filter_pattern(NULL,0) is called by u_interrupt at src/signal.rs:44-56. That replacement can release compiled filter-pattern ownership while pattern.rs/native search borrows it.
